cohort: The study included 23,861 full-term and premature infants screened in Ningbo, China, between January 2017 and July 2020.
finding: Ocular abnormalities were found in 27.8% of all newborns, with retinal hemorrhage being the most common in full-term infants (18.3%) and retinopathy of prematurity observed in 21.1% of premature infants.
mod_finding: The delivery method had a significant impact on the incidence of neonatal retinal hemorrhage (P < 0.001).
